views.rationale: BA reported a core operating loss with a -2.6% margin in 2019, while CVX’s international crude price fell but it still generated profit (downstream earnings $1.56B vs $2.10B in 2018)
BAC’s net interest income rose $729M to $48.9B in 2019, whereas CVX’s downstream earnings dropped $540M to $1.56B in 2019
LIN reported sales increased 90% in 2019 due to the merger, while JNJ's worldwide sales grew only 0.6% in 2019
JPM recorded revenue of $55.9 billion, up 7% YoY, whereas GS only disclosed an 11% rise in loan commitments (from $200.8 bn to $222.7 bn) without revenue growth
UNH revenue grew 6% for UnitedHealthcare and 26% for OptumHealth, while PG net sales rose only 5% to $18.2 billion
Consolidated net income rose to $15.2 billion in FY2020, up from $7.2 billion in FY2019 (≈111% increase)
